dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[FL-20250318-MOZ-00](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_fl_events/items?eventid=FL-20250318-MOZ-00) A flood occurred on Mar 18 2025 in Mozambique. It affected an estimated 566438 people and 62684 ha of cropland. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
